question: This is a topographic map. The contour interval is 20 meters, index contours (heavy lines) are every 100 meters, and elevations are in meters. Wildfire: a fire is burning at the magenta square F and a crew is at the magenta square S. Fire spreads fastest uphill, so the crew is safe only on a route that stays below the elevation of F the whole way. 4 escape trails (dashed black lines) leave S: Alder Trail, Flume Trail, Birch Trail and Ridge Trail. Exactly one of them never climbs to the elevation of F. Which trail should the crew take? Answer with the trail name, for example Alder Trail.
references: USGS 7.5-minute topographic quadrangle maps (US Topo, 1:24 000): brown contours, heavy index contours
Fire spreads faster upslope: NWCG wildland fire behavior training (S-190), slope as a topographic factor
